about: The UI lane's fixed questions for the parts library (P0): new screens in a brief's words (keywords = what a session would type into today's library search), written before any method was run on them. Every method's top answers are pooled and labelled blind by two labellers (labels.json); `kit parts ui eval` scores each method on them. Add a question only from real work, never to suit a method.

questions.brief: ammo counter HUD: a revolver cylinder showing the rounds left, a number for the spare ammo, a reload prompt when it is empty
quest tracker: a small panel on the right with the quest title, two objectives with check marks, a progress count
skill tree: nodes joined by lines on a dark board, locked and unlocked states, a tooltip with the skill's cost, a points counter
boss intro card: the boss's name in big lettering slides in with a subtitle, a portrait, a health bar fills up under it
questions.keywords: boss name title card health bar

questions.brief: inventory: a grid of item slots with rarity borders, a stack count on each slot, an item details panel, a weight bar
daily reward: seven day cards in a row, the claimed days greyed out, today's card glowing with a claim button, a streak counter
minimap: a round map in the corner with a compass ring, objective markers, the player's arrow in the centre
combo meter: a hit counter that pops bigger on each hit, a style rank letter, a timer bar that drains
settings menu: tabs for audio, graphics and controls, sliders for the volume, toggles, a back button
death screen: the screen fades dark red, big 'YOU DIED' lettering, a respawn countdown and a button to return
